light.description:
Light {current} of {total}: {name}.

Choose the button on the remote that turns this light on, and the one that turns it off. If the remote has only a single toggle button, choose that same button for both; the light can then only be toggled.

Not sure which button does what? Use "Try a button" to send one and watch the light.

data_description.test_button: Choose a button and submit to send it to the light. The form comes back so you can keep trying; leave this empty and submit to save your choice.
